summary: Pembina Pipeline Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing a news release that declares routine quarterly dividends on eight series of preferred shares and sets the date for its second-quarter 2026 earnings conference call. There are no terms or events indicative of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing is a standard periodic report and dividend announcement, not a special-situation event.
